note: A place where old or damaged vehicles and scrap are stored, dismantled, or sold; also written junkyard.

senses.m: A place where old or damaged vehicles and scrap are stored, dismantled, or sold
senses.pat: a car junk yard · sell a vehicle to a junk yard · junk-yard parts
ex: They found a replacement mirror at the junk yard.
Họ tìm được gương thay thế ở bãi phế liệu xe.
The old car was towed to a junkyard.
Chiếc xe cũ được kéo đến bãi phế liệu.

note: The enclosed area in a courtroom where jurors sit during a trial.

senses.m: The enclosed area in a courtroom where jurors sit during a trial
senses.pat: sit in the jury box · fill the jury box · the jury-box seats
ex: The jurors entered the jury box before the trial began.
Các bồi thẩm viên vào ghế dành cho bồi thẩm đoàn trước khi phiên xử bắt đầu.
The judge addressed the people seated in the jury box.
Thẩm phán phát biểu với những người ngồi trong khu vực bồi thẩm đoàn.

note: The sharps or flats written at the start of a musical staff to indicate the key; also called key sig.

senses.m: The sharps or flats written at the start of a musical staff to indicate the key
senses.pat: read the key signature · a key signature with three flats · change the key signature
ex: The key signature shows that the piece is in E-flat major.
Hóa biểu cho thấy bản nhạc ở giọng Mi giáng trưởng.
The student identified the key signature before playing.
Học sinh xác định hóa biểu trước khi chơi.

note: A large marine mammal, Orcinus orca, also called an orca; despite the name, it belongs to the dolphin family.

senses.m: A large marine mammal, Orcinus orca, also called an orca
senses.pat: a pod of killer whales · killer-whale habitat · observe an orca
ex: A pod of killer whales surfaced beside the boat.
Một đàn cá voi sát thủ nổi lên bên cạnh thuyền.
The aquarium now uses the name orca in its educational materials.
Thủy cung nay dùng tên orca trong tài liệu giáo dục.

note: A public holiday honoring workers; date and name vary by country. In the US and Canada it is observed in September; many countries observe May Day/International Workers’ Day in May.

senses.m: A public holiday honoring workers
senses.pat: Labor Day weekend · celebrate Labor Day · Labor Day parade
ex: The store will close for Labor Day.
Cửa hàng sẽ đóng cửa vào ngày Lễ Lao động.
The parade takes place on Labor Day weekend.
Cuộc diễu hành diễn ra vào dịp cuối tuần Lễ Lao động.

note: An organization representing workers in negotiations over pay, conditions, and rights; British spelling is labour union, often trade union.

senses.m: An organization representing workers in negotiations over pay, conditions, and rights
senses.pat: join a labor union · labor-union contract · negotiate with the union
ex: The workers formed a labor union at the factory.
Công nhân thành lập công đoàn tại nhà máy.
The labor union negotiated a new safety agreement.
Công đoàn thương lượng một thỏa thuận an toàn mới.

note: A region containing many lakes; often the Lake District refers to the national park in northwest England, officially the Lake District.

senses.m: A region containing many lakes
senses.pat: the Lake District in England · visit the Lake District · Lake District landscape
ex: They spent a week hiking in the Lake District.
Họ dành một tuần đi bộ đường dài ở Lake District.
The Lake District is known for its lakes and mountains.
Lake District nổi tiếng với hồ và núi.

note: A post supporting a street lamp; also called a lamppost or streetlight pole.

senses.m: A post supporting a street lamp
senses.pat: stand under a lamp post · a lamp-post light · lean against a lamp post
ex: The sign was fixed to a lamp post.
Biển báo được gắn trên cột đèn đường.
A cat was sitting beneath the lamp post.
Một con mèo ngồi dưới cột đèn.

note: A junior noncommissioned rank in some armed forces, above private and below corporal; exact equivalent varies by military.

senses.m: A junior noncommissioned rank in some armed forces, above private and below corporal
senses.pat: promote someone to lance corporal · a lance corporal in the army · lance-corporal rank
ex: He was promoted to lance corporal after training.
Anh được thăng cấp hạ sĩ sau khóa huấn luyện.
The lance corporal supervised the patrol.
Hạ sĩ giám sát đội tuần tra.

note: A large continuous area of land, especially a continent or island; also written landmass.

senses.m: A large continuous area of land, especially a continent or island
senses.pat: a large land mass · the Eurasian land mass · separate land masses
ex: Australia is a large land mass surrounded by ocean.
Úc là một vùng đất rộng lớn được đại dương bao quanh.
The two land masses were connected by a narrow bridge of land.
Hai vùng đất được nối với nhau bằng một dải đất hẹp.

note: A net attached to a handle, used to lift a fish or other object out of water.

senses.m: A net attached to a handle, used to lift a fish or other object out of water
senses.pat: scoop a fish into a landing net · use a landing net · a long-handled landing net
ex: She brought the fish close and lifted it with a landing net.
Cô kéo cá lại gần rồi vớt nó bằng vợt cán dài.
The angler kept a landing net beside the riverbank.
Người câu cá để sẵn vợt bên bờ sông.

note: A small dog suitable for sitting on someone’s lap; figuratively, a person or group seen as obedient to a powerful person, often insulting.

senses.m: A small dog suitable for sitting on someone’s lap
senses.pat: a pampered lap dog · hold a lap dog · accuse someone of being a lap dog
ex: The child held a small lap dog on the sofa.
Đứa trẻ ôm một chú chó nhỏ trong lòng trên ghế sofa.
Critics accused the committee of becoming a lap dog for the minister.
Những người chỉ trích cáo buộc ủy ban trở thành tay sai của bộ trưởng.

note: The parts of the Americas where Romance languages, especially Spanish and Portuguese, are predominant; definitions vary and may include French-speaking areas.

senses.m: The parts of the Americas where Romance languages, especially Spanish and Portuguese, are predominant
senses.pat: across Latin America · Latin American countries · Latin America trade
ex: The project supports schools across Latin America.
Dự án hỗ trợ các trường học trên khắp Mỹ Latinh.
Latin America includes countries with diverse histories and cultures.
Mỹ Latinh gồm các quốc gia có lịch sử và văn hóa đa dạng.

note: Relating to Latin America or a person from that region; use specific national or community identity when known.

senses.m: Relating to Latin America or a person from that region
senses.pat: Latin American literature · a Latin American artist · Latin American countries
ex: The festival features Latin American cinema.
Liên hoan giới thiệu điện ảnh Mỹ Latinh.
She is a Latin American writer based in Mexico City.
Cô là nhà văn Mỹ Latinh sống tại Thành phố Mexico.

note: To put something away for later; to set aside a feeling, disagreement, or plan temporarily.

senses.m: To put something away for later
senses.pat: lay aside savings · lay aside differences · lay a book aside
ex: They laid aside their disagreement to finish the project.
Họ tạm gác bất đồng để hoàn thành dự án.
She laid aside a little money each month.
Cô để dành một ít tiền mỗi tháng.

note: A rotating tray placed on a table or counter to let people reach items easily; the name is a common US term.

senses.m: A rotating tray placed on a table or counter to let people reach items easily
senses.pat: a table lazy Susan · spin the lazy Susan · put dishes on a lazy Susan
ex: The family shared dishes from a lazy Susan.
Cả gia đình lấy thức ăn từ mâm xoay ở giữa bàn.
She put the condiments on the lazy Susan.
Cô đặt các lọ gia vị lên mâm xoay.

note: The principal female actor in a film or play; sometimes a woman in a prominent or romantic role.

senses.m: The principal female actor in a film or play
senses.pat: play the leading lady · a film’s leading lady · cast someone as leading lady
ex: She was cast as the leading lady in the musical.
Cô được chọn đóng vai nữ chính trong vở nhạc kịch.
The director praised his leading lady’s performance.
Đạo diễn khen ngợi diễn xuất của nữ chính.

note: The principal male actor in a film or play; sometimes a man in a prominent or romantic role.

senses.m: The principal male actor in a film or play
senses.pat: play the leading man · a film’s leading man · cast someone as leading man
ex: He became the leading man in several historical dramas.
Anh trở thành nam chính trong một số phim chính kịch lịch sử.
The leading man thanked the cast after the premiere.
Nam chính cảm ơn đoàn diễn sau buổi công chiếu.

note: A staffed place at a station or airport where travelers can leave bags temporarily; British English. US terms include baggage storage or left-luggage facility.

senses.m: A staffed place at a station or airport where travelers can leave bags temporarily
senses.pat: leave a bag at the left luggage office · collect luggage from · station left-luggage office
ex: We left our suitcases at the left luggage office.
Chúng tôi gửi va-li tại quầy giữ hành lý.
The left luggage office closes at six.
Quầy giữ hành lý đóng cửa lúc sáu giờ.

note: The left-hand side of a building, political movement, or sports formation; in politics, generally associated with egalitarian or progressive positions, but meanings vary.

senses.m: The left-hand side of a building, political movement, or sports formation
senses.pat: the left wing of a building · a left-wing party · play on the left wing
ex: The museum’s left wing is closed for renovation.
Cánh trái của bảo tàng đóng cửa để cải tạo.
The candidate belongs to the left wing of the party.
Ứng viên thuộc cánh tả của đảng.
